_doc: THE SPINE — the worldbible campaign's twelve chapters as a declarative chapter map riding the quest framework. This file is the MAP, not new quests: every chapter references existing quest ids (the earl chain regrouped across the acts + the companion arcs surfacing as the elastic middle). Data-only — Tracker already evaluates every referenced quest. See docs/SPINE.md.

chapters.title: The Gate Is Never Locked
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act One · Ch 1 — 'The Gate Is Never Locked'
chapters.skill: Salvage fundamentals — what the yard's blocks are, what they drop, why materials matter
chapters.delight: The first dusk-to-floodlight transition seen from the gate — the yard lights up like a promise

pullVector.bolt: Nothing to race yet — Bolt clocks your salvage pace anyway and files it under 'potential'.
pullVector.magma: The workshop hum starts here — Magma watches the first haul for heavy-metal promise.
pullVector.juno: Forty little fliers buzz the gate — Juno's already asking who you are and what you'll break.
pullVector.rivet: Arrived the same day you did — Rivet walks the Gate band at your shoulder, learning the yard as you learn it.

chapters.openingLine: You showed up with a wagon and no plan. Good — the yard's got plans enough for both of us.

chapters.title: Earn Your Tools
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act One · Ch 2 — 'Earn Your Tools'
chapters.skill: The crafting pipeline — inputs, stations, tiers; the right tool gates the right job
chapters.delight: Your first hand-made wrench gets Earl's grudging nod — and Rivet's full-body slow-blink

pullVector.bolt: Tools mean pit crew — Bolt mutters that a wrench is just a wheel wrench running slow.
pullVector.magma: Leans all the way in: the bench is Magma's church, and your first circuit board is the sermon.
pullVector.juno: Bored by benches — Juno drifts, but pockets a copper wire 'for a question I'm saving.'
pullVector.rivet: Certifies your first build by sleeping on it — the slow-blink is this chapter's whole grade.

chapters.openingLine: Bench is open, sympathy's closed — build yourself a wrench.

chapters.title: Something With Thumbs
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act One · Ch 3 — 'Something With Thumbs'
chapters.skill: System assembly — actuators, chassis, power; the moment a pile of parts becomes a someone
chapters.delight: First boot beep — the yard anthem's first six notes, and every NPC in earshot glances over

pullVector.bolt: A bot with thumbs could hold a helmet — Bolt pretends not to care, then checks the actuators twice.
pullVector.magma: Actuators, chassis, power — Magma's home chapter; the lifter hands you the heavy parts.
pullVector.juno: The swarm escorts your battery delivery — to Juno, ceremony is just a very polite sensor reading.
pullVector.rivet: First shift with a teammate — Rivet logs the boot beep before it finishes.

chapters.openingLine: A pile of parts is just a pile, kid — right up until the day it beeps.

chapters.title: One Knob at a Time
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act One · Ch 4 — 'One Knob at a Time'
chapters.skill: The feedback loop — sense, think, act; one-variable-at-a-time debugging (the campaign's spine skill)
chapters.delight: The first autonomous run — three obstacles avoided, a clean park, and Spark does a little flip

pullVector.bolt: 'A wall-avoider is a race program in diapers' — Bolt leans on the editor rail with old pit tricks.
pullVector.magma: Prefers the build bench to the editor, but goes flash-adjacent — Magma starts talking real boards.
pullVector.juno: The confound discipline IS a weird question — Juno leans in hard: hypothesis, run, watch.
pullVector.rivet: The balanced curriculum says program's next on the card — Rivet sits on the desk like a paperweight with opinions.

chapters.openingLine: One knob at a time, genius — change everything and you'll learn nothing but confusion.

chapters.title: The Oval Has Opinions
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act Two · Ch 5 — 'The Oval Has Opinions'
chapters.skill: Closed-loop feedback — line-following, thresholds, why repeatable beats fast
chapters.delight: Your name on the chalkboard at the bottom, in a color June picked 'for visibility'

pullVector.bolt: Home turf — Bolt owns the pit wall, times your splits, and calls the 0.4 seconds 'a generous margin'.
pullVector.magma: Speed hardware is still hardware — Magma quietly upgrades your motor driver between heats.
pullVector.juno: Surveys the Oval's geometry for the swarm map — and asks June what the chalk colors mean.
pullVector.rivet: The curriculum says race — Rivet patrols the oval edge, keeping your bot together lap after lap.

chapters.openingLine: June runs it in twenty-three flat. You're about to lose by four tenths — go find out what a tenth is.

chapters.title: The Library of Almosts
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act Two · Ch 6 — 'The Library of Almosts'
chapters.skill: Sensor interpretation & calibration — the Deep Yard's hazards make sensors matter
chapters.delight: Quill pays you in a crystal that hums when the weather's about to turn — and it's right

pullVector.bolt: Nothing to race in the boneyard — Bolt hangs back, but tells you which ruts eat speed anyway.
pullVector.magma: The Deep Yard prototypes are Magma's lost cousins — the lifter reads the wrecks like family albums.
pullVector.juno: This is Juno's chapter — wind-chimes, weird questions, sensors that matter; the swarm goes in first.
pullVector.rivet: Walks point through the clutter — a repair drone's map of 'almost worked' is a parts list.

chapters.openingLine: Past the warehouses the pavement quits and the junk gets honest — that's the Deep Yard.

chapters.title: The Same Robot, Real
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act Two · Ch 7 — 'The Same Robot, Real'
chapters.skill: Hardware abstraction — game brain to real firmware; the three-tier ladder (intent → tiles → code)
chapters.delight: Your own program scrolling past as real C++ — Spark vibrating: 'THAT'S YOUR BRAIN IN CODE LANGUAGE'

pullVector.bolt: 'Same brain, real chip' — Bolt watched this trick at Brightworks and still pretends it's routine.
pullVector.magma: All the way in — real code and real power are Magma's religion; the export header gets shown around the workshop.
pullVector.juno: Asks Spark who QA-Sticker #7 is — then goes quiet for exactly one second too long itself.
pullVector.rivet: Certifies the export the only way Rivet certifies: sleeps on the receipt, slow-blinks the diagram.

chapters.openingLine: Game robot, real robot, same program — today you find out I wasn't kidding.

chapters.title: Fail Loudly
chapters.skill: Failure analysis — post-mortems as curriculum; debugging as reading the past
chapters.delight: The Codex unlocks 'Fail Loudly' and every plaque-wreck's floodlight flickers on in sequence — failure, lit up like an honor guard

pullVector.bolt: Reads the crash plaques like race post-mortems — half these wrecks Bolt watched from the pits.
pullVector.magma: Brownout, stall current, thermals — Magma recites the plaques from memory; failures are workshop scripture.
pullVector.juno: The plaque trail is Juno's syllabus — every wreck is a question the yard already answered.
pullVector.rivet: Patrols plaque to plaque — the keeper's round was always this walk, just unnamed.

chapters.openingLine: Every wreck out there wrote a letter to whoever's next. You're next, kid — read your mail.

chapters.title: Candlelight at 11:58
chapters.skill: Sensing in low-signal regimes — light thresholds, filtering, night calibration; evidence discipline
chapters.delight: Goosebumps as gameplay — floods dip to night mode, one candlelight beacon takes the first corner, and the yard goes silent except the timing post

pullVector.bolt: Midnight on the oval is Bolt's old shift — it teaches you to stand still and watch the corner.
pullVector.magma: Night goggles and floodlight wiring — Magma checks your lamp twice; dark workshops are its origin story.
pullVector.juno: Low-signal sensing is Juno's favorite mystery — the swarm dims its lights to watch with you.
pullVector.rivet: Sits at your boot the whole watch — the first to believe you about the candlelight.

chapters.openingLine: Floods dip at 11:58 — stand still, watch the candlelight corner, and don't you dare holler.

chapters.title: The Manifest of Midnights
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act Two · Ch 10 — 'The Manifest of Midnights'
chapters.skill: Data logging & signal analysis — the engineer-as-detective toolkit: compare, timestamp, correlate
chapters.delight: The Ghost's tire tracks chalked onto the oval with the whole crew — lining up with nobody's steering but Earl's certification choreography

pullVector.bolt: Tire treads and steering patterns — Bolt can read a corner in a chalk line and proves it on the oval.
pullVector.magma: Builds the gear that gets numbers — radar, loggers, the antenna you wind yourself.
pullVector.juno: Correlation is a weird question asked forty ways — the swarm times the 11:58 clicks to the second.
pullVector.rivet: Walks the manifest route with Ox — twenty years of patrol finally has a reason.

chapters.openingLine: Hunches don't open shed doors — bring me numbers: treads, ticks, timestamps.

chapters.title: The Back Room
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act Three · Ch 11 — 'The Back Room'
chapters.skill: Integration — multi-system rebuild under constraint; every plaque lesson is one of Mo's rebuild tasks
chapters.delight: Mo's two-note thank-you chirp, three times — 'she's been saving them up' — and urgent shed-business gets invented by everyone

pullVector.bolt: Tuning Mo's line sensor like it's race day — because it is; the pit crew assembles itself.
pullVector.magma: The rebuild is Magma's masterclass — every plaque lesson is a bolt to torque and it knows them all.
pullVector.juno: The swarm stands honor guard at the back room door — even forty fliers know a somebody when she beeps.
pullVector.rivet: The keeper's round ends at the bench where it started — Rivet supervises the rebuild, then sleeps on it.

chapters.openingLine: Back room's open. First time in twenty-six years — mind the boxes marked M.

chapters.title: The Midnight Race
chapters.bibleAnchor: worldbible/campaign.md · Act Three · Ch 12 — 'The Midnight Race'
chapters.skill: Everything, integrated — night racing, closed loops, tuned thresholds, race-day power checks
chapters.delight: Mo's long tone rising at the finish — confetti, the anthem's six notes from every bot, and: LAP 1. TIME: TWENTY-SIX YEARS.

pullVector.bolt: One last hot lap before midnight — Bolt writes the pit board and finally says the word 'ready.'
pullVector.magma: Voltage checks before the finals — Magma taps the battery like a keg and calls it race-day-proof.
pullVector.juno: Times the anthem's six notes from every bot in the yard — the swarm's chorus, on cue at the line.
pullVector.rivet: Takes the last corner post with Earl — the certification slow-blink is already loaded for Mo.

chapters.openingLine: Floodlights, midnight, whole town in the bleachers — you get the gate, kid. I'll take the last corner.
